[Story]
A toy store has 30 different toys. The owner tells the assistant that most of them are toy cars, with only a small part being dolls and board games. After checking, the assistant finds that only 5 types are doll toys.

[Question]
How many does the assistant guess are toy cars after checking?

[Candidate Answers]
A. After checking, the assistant guesses there are 20 toy cars.
B. After checking, the assistant guesses there are 25 toy cars.
C. After checking, the assistant guesses there are 15 toy cars.
D. After checking, the assistant guesses there are 29 toy cars.
